intent.raw_query: Patagonia hiking Torres del Paine, $4500, 12 days, December 2026

selected_hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Torres del Paine, Patagonia

experiences.name: W Trek Multi-Day Hike
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic W Trek, a 4-5 day trekking route through the heart of Torres del Paine National Park. The trail connects the Valle del Francés, Grey Glacier, and the iconic Torres lookout, offering breathtaking views of granite towers, turquoise lakes, and diverse Patagonian wildlife including guanacos and condors.
experiences.location: Torres del Paine National Park, Central Circuit

experiences.name: Mirador Las Torres Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Wake before dawn and hike 4-5 hours to the iconic mirador at the base of the three granite towers. Witness the sunrise paint the towers in shades of gold and pink reflected in the glacial lagoon below. This is the most photographed and spiritually rewarding moment in all of Patagonia.
experiences.location: Valle del Ascencio, Eastern Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Grey Glacier Kayaking Expedition
experiences.description: Paddle through iceberg-studded waters alongside the massive Grey Glacier, one of Patagonia's most spectacular ice fields. A guided kayaking tour takes you up close to towering blue ice walls and floating icebergs calved from the Southern Patagonian Ice Field, offering a unique water-level perspective of this frozen giant.
experiences.location: Lago Grey, Western Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Valle del Francés Trekking Day
experiences.description: Hike through the dramatic Valle del Francés, a glacially carved valley flanked by hanging glaciers, waterfalls, and jagged peaks including Paine Grande and Cuernos del Paine. Listen for the thunderous crack of ice avalanches and spot Andean condors soaring overhead in this wild and remote wilderness corridor.
experiences.location: Valle del Francés, Central Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Lago Pehoé Catamaran & Pampas Wildlife Walk
experiences.description: Cross the stunning turquoise Lago Pehoé by catamaran with panoramic views of the Cuernos del Paine, then explore the open Patagonian pampas on a guided nature walk. Spot guanacos, ñandus (rheas), foxes, and flamingos in their natural habitat while learning about the unique Patagonian steppe ecosystem from a certified naturalist guide.
experiences.location: Lago Pehoé, Southern Sector, Torres del Paine

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Punta Arenas or Puerto Natales airport at 22:30 on flight UA. Arrange pre-booked budget transfer or shared shuttle to accommodation near Torres del Paine. Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort and rest after long travel day.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or airport snacks
meals.lunch: Airport food court or packed snacks from home
meals.dinner: Grab a quick bite at a local kiosk or convenience store near the airport before transfer - budget around $5-8 USD

day_by_day.notes: Late arrival - do not plan any activities. Confirm shuttle or transfer booking in advance. Keep snacks and water handy for the transfer. Pack light layers as Patagonia nights are cold even in December.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. After a late breakfast, spend the morning organizing your gear, downloading offline maps (Maps.me or Gaia GPS), and purchasing a park entrance pass online or at the CONAF office. Familiarize yourself with the W Trek route and trailhead locations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a short acclimatization walk near the resort to stretch your legs. Explore the local area around your accommodation, visit the nearest town (Puerto Natales if nearby) to stock up on budget trail snacks - nuts, dried fruit, energy bars, instant noodles - at a local supermarket like Unimarc.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort, organize your backpack and trekking gear for the coming days. Review weather forecasts on the Patagonia weather app or wunderground.com. Rest early to prepare for the trek ahead.

meals.breakfast: Simple breakfast at the resort or self-catered oats with fruit - budget $3-5 USD
meals.lunch: Supermarket sandwich or empanadas from a local bakery in town - budget $4-6 USD
meals.dinner: Cook a simple pasta or rice meal using resort kitchen facilities, or eat at a local budget restaurant - budget $8-12 USD

day_by_day.notes: Park entrance fee for Torres del Paine is approximately $35 USD per person in high season. Buy online at torresdelpaine.com to avoid queues. Stock up on at least 3-4 days of trail food to save money inside the park.

day_by_day.morning: Early start - depart resort by 7:00 AM and take a budget bus or shared transfer to the park entrance (Laguna Amarga or Pudeto). Pay park entrance fee if not already done. Begin hiking the first leg of the W Trek toward Las Torres base. Trail starts at Hotel Las Torres trailhead.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue hiking up the well-marked trail through lenga beech forest and open rocky terrain toward Mirador Las Torres. The hike is approximately 8-9 km one way with 700m elevation gain. Take your time and enjoy the glacial lake views at the base of the three granite towers.
day_by_day.evening: Return down the trail to the campsite area. Set up camp at Camping Torres (budget campsite with basic facilities) or Torres Central campsite. Cook a hot meal on your camping stove and enjoy the golden Patagonian sunset light on the towers.

meals.breakfast: Oats with powdered milk and dried fruit cooked on camping stove or at resort before departure - budget $2-3 USD
meals.lunch: Trail lunch on the go - energy bars, nuts, cheese, crackers, dried mango - budget $4-5 USD
meals.dinner: Instant noodles or dehydrated camping meal cooked at campsite - budget $4-6 USD

day_by_day.notes: Camping Torres costs approximately $10-15 USD per person per night. Book in advance through vertice.cl or fantasticosur.com as spots fill up fast in December. Bring all your own food and a reliable camping stove with fuel canister.

day_by_day.morning: Wake at 4:30 AM for the iconic Mirador Las Torres Sunrise Hike. Hike 4-5 hours from campsite to the mirador at the base of the three granite towers before dawn. The pre-dawn light on the towers reflected in the glacial lagoon is one of Patagonia's most breathtaking sights. Bring headlamp, warm layers, and snacks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend back to the campsite, pack up camp, and begin hiking westward along the W Trek toward Valle del Francés. Pass through open pampas with guanaco sightings and cross the Ascencio River. Stop at Camping Cuernos for a rest and lunch break.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Camping Italiano or Camping Francés at the entrance to Valle del Francés. Set up camp, cook dinner, and rest your legs. The sound of distant glacier calving echoes through the valley at night.

meals.breakfast: Pre-packed energy bars and a thermos of hot tea or coffee consumed on the trail before sunrise - budget $2 USD
meals.lunch: Trail mix, peanut butter wraps, and an apple at Camping Cuernos - budget $4-5 USD
meals.dinner: Instant mashed potatoes with tuna packets and olive oil at campsite - budget $5-6 USD

day_by_day.notes: This is the highlight day of the trip - do not skip the sunrise hike even if tired. Camping Italiano is free but has limited facilities. Camping Francés is paid. The W Trek section from Las Torres to Francés is approximately 11 km - allow 4-5 hours of walking time.

day_by_day.morning: Valle del Francés Trekking Day - Begin hiking up the stunning glacially carved valley flanked by hanging glaciers and dramatic rock walls. The round trip to the upper mirador is approximately 10-12 km with 600m elevation gain. Watch for condors soaring overhead and listen for thundering avalanches from the Francés Glacier.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue up to Mirador Británico (the highest viewpoint in the valley) for panoramic views of the Cuernos del Paine, Glacier Francés, and surrounding peaks. Take your time at the top before descending back to camp. The valley offers some of the most dramatic mountain scenery in all of Patagonia.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Camping Italiano or Francés, rest sore muscles, and cook a hearty dinner. Socialize with fellow trekkers from around the world - a great way to exchange tips and travel stories. Enjoy the long Patagonian summer evening light.

meals.breakfast: Instant oatmeal with honey and nuts at campsite - budget $2-3 USD
meals.lunch: Packed lunch eaten at Mirador Británico - crackers, hard cheese, salami, and chocolate - budget $5 USD
meals.dinner: Pasta with olive oil, garlic powder, and tuna at campsite - budget $5-6 USD

day_by_day.notes: Valle del Francés is considered the most spectacular section of the W Trek. The hanging glaciers can calve at any time - stay on marked trails and away from glacier edges. Weather in the valley can change rapidly - always carry rain gear and extra warm layers.

day_by_day.morning: Pack up camp and continue the W Trek westward toward Lago Pehoé and the Grey Glacier sector. Hike through open terrain with stunning views of Lago Nordenskjöld and the Cuernos del Paine. The trail passes Refugio Paine Grande - a good spot to refill water and use toilet facilities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Drop bags at Camping Paine Grande (budget camping area) and take the afternoon hike northward toward Glacier Grey. The trail follows the lakeshore of Lago Grey with views of floating icebergs and the massive Grey Glacier snout. Hike as far as Mirador Grey for close-up views of the glacier face.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Camping Paine Grande. This is a larger campsite with better facilities including a refugio with a basic restaurant if you want to treat yourself. Otherwise cook your own meal and enjoy the views of Lago Pehoé and the Paine massif at sunset.

meals.breakfast: Instant coffee and granola bars at campsite before packing up - budget $2 USD
meals.lunch: Eat lunch on the trail - peanut butter tortillas and dried fruit - budget $4-5 USD
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly on a bowl of soup at Refugio Paine Grande restaurant if budget allows ($8-10 USD) or cook instant soup and rice at campsite - budget $5-8 USD

day_by_day.notes: Camping Paine Grande costs approximately $10-15 USD per person. The catamaran across Lago Pehoé is an alternative to hiking but costs $25-35 USD each way - skip it to save money and enjoy the lakeside trail instead. Paine Grande has charging stations for small fee.

day_by_day.morning: Full day at Glacier Grey sector. Wake early and hike the full Grey Glacier trail (approximately 11 km round trip to the upper viewpoints). The glacier is one of the largest in Patagonia outside of the ice fields. Watch for blue icebergs floating in Lago Grey and condors riding thermals above.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the glacier hike and spend the afternoon resting at camp. Take a short walk along the lakeshore to spot wildlife including Andean foxes, guanacos, and black-necked swans. Optional: rent a kayak from the refugio to paddle among small icebergs if budget allows ($20-25 USD per hour).
day_by_day.evening: Final evening on the W Trek trail. Cook a celebratory dinner with any remaining trail food. Watch the sunset over Lago Pehoé and the Paine massif - one of the most iconic views in all of Patagonia. Reflect on the incredible week of hiking.

meals.breakfast: Hot oatmeal and instant coffee at campsite - budget $2-3 USD
meals.lunch: Last of the trail snacks - nuts, energy bars, remaining crackers and cheese - budget $3-5 USD
meals.dinner: Special camp dinner - instant couscous with dried vegetables and olive oil, hot chocolate for dessert - budget $6-7 USD

day_by_day.notes: This is the turnaround point of the W Trek. Tomorrow you begin the return journey. Make sure to leave no trace - pack out all waste. Water from the glacier streams is safe to drink when filtered. Daylight in Patagonia in December lasts until nearly 10:30 PM.

day_by_day.morning: Pack up camp at Paine Grande and take the catamaran or hike back toward the park exit via Pudeto. If hiking, the trail back along Lago Pehoé is beautiful and free. Take the bus from park entrance back toward Puerto Natales or return to resort accommodation for a rest day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive back at Aegean Bliss Resort or Puerto Natales. Shower, do laundry, and rest tired legs. Visit Puerto Natales town center to explore the small but charming streets. Visit the waterfront Seno Última Esperanza (Last Hope Sound) for views of the mountains and condors.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a proper sit-down dinner at a budget restaurant in Puerto Natales. Explore the town's craft beer scene at Cervecería Baguales (local Patagonian brewery) for an affordable pint and burger. Rest and recover for the remaining days.

meals.breakfast: Quick campsite breakfast before packing up - instant oats - budget $2 USD
meals.lunch: Empanadas or a sandwich from a local bakery in Puerto Natales - budget $4-6 USD
meals.dinner: Budget restaurant dinner in Puerto Natales - try local lamb stew (cordero) or centolla (king crab) soup at El Living or Afrigonia - budget $12-15 USD

day_by_day.notes: The catamaran from Paine Grande to Pudeto costs approximately $25 USD and saves 3-4 hours of hiking. Worth it after 6 days of trekking. Puerto Natales is the main service town for the park with supermarkets, gear rental shops, and budget hostels.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day. Sleep in and have a leisurely breakfast. Visit the Museo Histórico Municipal in Puerto Natales (free or very cheap entry) to learn about the history of Patagonia, the indigenous Kawésqar people, and the region's natural history.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Milodon Cave Natural Monument (Monumento Natural Cueva del Milodón) located 24 km north of Puerto Natales. Take a local bus or hitchhike (common and safe in Patagonia). The cave housed a prehistoric giant ground sloth and offers easy walking trails with great views.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Puerto Natales or resort. Visit the local market for fresh produce and cook a budget meal. Alternatively, try Patagonia Sur Hostel's communal kitchen for a social cooking experience with other travelers.

meals.breakfast: Full breakfast at resort or hostel - eggs, toast, fruit, coffee - budget $5-7 USD
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or picnic near Milodon Cave - supermarket sandwiches and juice - budget $5-6 USD
meals.dinner: Self-cooked meal using fresh local ingredients from the market - lamb chops or fresh vegetables with pasta - budget $8-10 USD

day_by_day.notes: Milodon Cave entrance fee is approximately $5 USD. The site is a UNESCO World Heritage area. Hitchhiking in Patagonia is culturally accepted and commonly practiced by budget travelers - always use common sense and travel in pairs when possible.

day_by_day.morning: Christmas Eve day adventure - take a day trip to explore the Serrano River and Bernardo O'Higgins National Park area. Arrange a budget boat tour on the Serrano River (cheaper group tours available from Puerto Natales for approximately $50-60 USD) to see hanging glaciers and condors.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the boat tour to Glacier Serrano or return by mid-afternoon. Alternatively, rent a bicycle in Puerto Natales and cycle the scenic coastal road along Seno Última Esperanza for free. Watch for pink flamingos, black-necked swans, and Andean condors along the waterway.
day_by_day.evening: Christmas Eve celebration - splurge slightly on a special dinner at a local Patagonian restaurant. Many restaurants in Puerto Natales offer a special Nochebuena (Christmas Eve) menu featuring local lamb asado. Join the festive atmosphere in the town plaza.

meals.breakfast: Medialunas (Argentine croissants) and coffee at a local café - budget $4-5 USD
meals.lunch: Packed lunch on the boat or riverside - budget $5 USD
meals.dinner: Christmas Eve special dinner at a local restaurant - budget $15-20 USD as a treat

day_by_day.notes: Christmas Eve (Nochebuena) is widely celebrated in Chile. Many businesses close early or have special hours. Book dinner reservations in advance. The Serrano River boat tours are best booked through local operators in Puerto Natales - compare prices at multiple agencies to get the best deal.

day_by_day.morning: Christmas Day - Enjoy a relaxed morning. Have a special breakfast at the resort or a local café. Take a gentle morning walk along the waterfront of Puerto Natales or around the resort area. Watch the sunrise over the mountains and appreciate the stunning natural surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Torres del Paine for a final day hike. Take the bus to the park and do a shorter, non-W Trek hike such as the Mirador Condor trail or the circuit around Laguna Verde and Laguna Azul in the less-visited northern sector. These free trails offer solitude and excellent wildlife viewing.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort for the final night. Pack bags and organize gear for departure. Enjoy a final sunset view of the Paine massif. Have a simple but satisfying dinner and celebrate the completion of an incredible Patagonian adventure.

meals.breakfast: Special Christmas breakfast - scrambled eggs, fresh bread, coffee, and fruit at resort or local café - budget $6-8 USD
meals.lunch: Picnic lunch in the park with leftover trail food and fresh fruit - budget $4-5 USD
meals.dinner: Final dinner at resort or a favorite local restaurant - try the local centolla (king crab) or lamb if budget allows - budget $12-15 USD

day_by_day.notes: Many businesses are closed on Christmas Day in Chile. Plan food and transport in advance. The northern sector of Torres del Paine (Laguna Azul, Laguna Verde) is far less crowded than the W Trek and offers excellent guanaco, rhea, and condor sightings. Park bus schedules may be reduced on holidays.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Patagonia. Wake up for one last sunrise view of the mountains. Take a short walk around the resort area to soak in the scenery. Have a leisurely breakfast and check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Visit any last souvenir shops in Puerto Natales for budget-friendly mementos - locally made wool items or postcards.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer to Punta Arenas airport for departure flight. Allow at least 3-4 hours for the bus journey from Puerto Natales to Punta Arenas (approximately $10-12 USD by shared bus with Bus Sur or Buses Fernández). Arrive at airport with plenty of time for check-in and security.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Patagonia. If flight is delayed or evening departure, explore Punta Arenas briefly - visit the iconic Cementerio Municipal (free, stunning cemetery with cypress trees) or the Plaza Muñoz Gamero in the city center. Grab a final empanada or sopaipilla at a local bakery before flying out.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast or café stop - coffee and toast - budget $4-5 USD
meals.lunch: Airport lunch or a quick bite in Punta Arenas city center - budget $6-8 USD
meals.dinner: Airport food or in-flight meal depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Book bus from Puerto Natales to Punta Arenas in advance during the December high season as seats fill quickly. The journey is approximately 3 hours. Punta Arenas airport (PUQ) is small but has basic facilities. Reconfirm your return flight 24 hours before departure. Total estimated budget for 12 days excluding flights: $400-550 USD including park fees, camping, food, and local transport.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight UA arrives at 22:30. Rest and prepare for transfer.
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — in transit.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Punta Arenas or Puerto Natales airport at 22:30. Collect luggage, meet pre-arranged transfer driver, and begin 1.5–2 hour transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort in Torres del Paine. Check in, freshen up, and get a good night's rest.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the departure airport.
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the departure airport.
meals.dinner: Grab a light snack from the resort's 24-hour welcome basket or request a late-arrival cold plate from the front desk — most mid-range Patagonian lodges accommodate late arrivals with a pre-arranged cold supper.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book your airport transfer in advance. Confirm late check-in with Aegean Bliss Resort. Pack a light snack in your carry-on for the road transfer. December nights in Patagonia are long with extended twilight — it won't be fully dark even at 22:30.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. After a leisurely breakfast, take a gentle orientation walk around the resort grounds and the nearby lakeshore to acclimate to Patagonia's wind, altitude, and light. Breathe in the scenery and spot local birdlife such as upland geese and Andean condors overhead.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the Lago Pehoé Catamaran & Pampas Wildlife Walk experience. Cross the stunning turquoise Lago Pehoé by catamaran with panoramic views of the Cuernos del Paine massif. Disembark and take a guided pampas walk spotting guanacos, ñandús (rheas), and foxes across the open steppe landscape.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Shower and relax on the beachfront terrace watching the alpenglow paint the Torres pink. Enjoy a quiet dinner at the resort restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — fuel up with eggs, local cold cuts, fresh bread, and coffee.
meals.lunch: Light packed lunch or snack bar on the catamaran excursion, or a quick bite at the Paine Grande refugio café.
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant. Order the Patagonian lamb stew (cordero al palo) or a hearty lentil soup — mid-range set menu typically runs $25–40 USD per person.

day_by_day.notes: This is a deliberate easy day to recover from travel and orient yourself. Wear layers — Patagonian weather can shift from sunshine to wind and rain within an hour. The catamaran schedule is weather-dependent; confirm departure times the evening before with the resort concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Early start for the Mirador Las Torres Sunrise Hike. Wake at 04:00, enjoy a quick coffee and energy bar, then depart by 04:30 with a certified guide. Hike 4–5 hours up the rocky trail through lenga beech forest to the iconic mirador at the base of the three granite towers. Arrive at the glacial lake just as the first golden light strikes the towers — one of Patagonia's most breathtaking moments.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend the trail at a relaxed pace, enjoying views of Lago Nordenskjöld and the surrounding valleys. Stop at Refugio Las Torres for a well-earned hot lunch before the return transfer to the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort by mid-afternoon. Rest tired legs with a warm shower or optional massage at the resort spa. Light stretching session on the beachfront deck. Early dinner and an early bedtime to recover.

meals.breakfast: Pre-packed energy breakfast prepared by the resort the night before — banana, energy bar, thermos of coffee/tea.
meals.lunch: Hot meal at Refugio Las Torres restaurant — try the pasta or hearty soup. Budget approximately $18–25 USD.
meals.dinner: Light dinner at the resort — grilled fish, salad, and local craft beer from a Chilean microbrewery.

day_by_day.notes: This is the most demanding single-day hike of the trip. Wear waterproof hiking boots, bring trekking poles, a rain jacket, sunscreen, and at least 2 liters of water. The total round-trip is approximately 18–20 km with 800 m elevation gain. Book a licensed guide through the resort — solo hiking to the mirador before dawn is not recommended. December offers the best chance of clear skies but afternoon clouds are common.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning. Sleep in, enjoy a long breakfast, and spend time journaling or reading on the beachfront terrace. Optional gentle yoga or stretching session to ease sore muscles from yesterday's hike.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the area immediately around the resort on a self-guided nature walk along the shoreline. Watch for black-necked swans, steamer ducks, and flamingos on the lake shallows. Visit the resort's information center to study maps and plan upcoming W Trek sections.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a complimentary ranger or naturalist talk at the resort (many Patagonian lodges offer these in peak season) about the park's ecology, glaciology, and wildlife. Dinner at the resort with a glass of Chilean Carménère wine.

meals.breakfast: Full resort buffet — take your time and eat well.
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the resort's lakeside café — empanadas, avocado toast, or a simple sandwich plate.
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant — try the king crab (centolla) if available, or a vegetarian cazuela stew. Mid-range set menu with wine.

day_by_day.notes: Active rest days are essential in multi-day trekking itineraries to prevent injury and burnout. Use this day to repack your daypack, charge all devices, and confirm W Trek logistics with the resort concierge. December is peak season — confirm all refugio bookings well in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the W Trek Multi-Day Hike — Day 1. Transfer by catamaran across Lago Pehoé to Paine Grande refugio, the western anchor of the W. Check in, store extra gear, and begin the afternoon section of the trek.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hike from Paine Grande northwest toward Grey Glacier (approximately 11 km one way). Walk along the shores of Lago Grey, watching icebergs drift in brilliant shades of blue and white. Reach Refugio Grey and check in for the night.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into Refugio Grey. Warm up with hot drinks by the wood stove, swap stories with fellow trekkers from around the world, and enjoy a communal refugio dinner. Watch the late Patagonian sunset (around 22:00 in December) paint the glacier in gold.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast before departure — eat heartily.
meals.lunch: Packed lunch prepared by the resort or purchased at Paine Grande refugio café — sandwich, fruit, chocolate.
meals.dinner: Set dinner at Refugio Grey (included with refugio booking) — typically pasta, soup, and bread. Simple but filling.

day_by_day.notes: Pack only what you need for 4 days on the W Trek — leave non-essential luggage stored at Aegean Bliss Resort. Refugio Grey accommodates 60–80 trekkers; book months in advance during December peak season. Bring a sleeping bag liner even if refugio blankets are provided. Wind on the Grey Glacier section can be extreme — secure all loose gear.

day_by_day.morning: W Trek Day 2 — Grey Glacier Kayaking Expedition. Rise early for an optional guided kayaking session on Lago Grey alongside the glacier face. Paddle through iceberg-studded turquoise waters with the massive Grey Glacier wall rising before you — one of Patagonia's most spectacular close-up glacier experiences.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return kayaks and begin the return hike from Refugio Grey back toward Paine Grande (11 km). The return journey offers different light and angles on the glacier and lake. Arrive at Paine Grande by late afternoon and check in.
day_by_day.evening: Rest at Paine Grande refugio. Hot shower (coin-operated at some refugios — bring coins or tokens), dinner, and early sleep to prepare for the Valle del Francés section tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at Refugio Grey before kayaking — porridge, toast, eggs, and coffee.
meals.lunch: Packed lunch on the trail — energy bars, dried fruit, nuts, and a sandwich.
meals.dinner: Set dinner at Paine Grande refugio — hearty soup and a main course. Budget approximately $25–35 USD if paying à la carte.

day_by_day.notes: The kayaking excursion must be pre-booked and is weather-dependent. Dry suits are provided but dress in warm base layers underneath. The Grey Glacier is actively calving — never approach floating icebergs closely. Trekking poles are highly recommended for the rocky Grey section trail.

day_by_day.morning: W Trek Day 3 — Valle del Francés Trekking Day. Depart Paine Grande early and hike northeast along the shores of Lago Skottsberg and into the dramatic Valle del Francés. The glacially carved valley is flanked by hanging glaciers on the Paine massif and towering granite walls. Listen for the thunderous crack of ice avalanches.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue up the valley to the upper mirador (Mirador Británico) for sweeping 360-degree views of the Cuernos del Paine, Glaciar del Francés, and the surrounding peaks. Descend back through the valley and continue east along the W route toward Refugio Los Cuernos.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Refugio Los Cuernos on the shore of Lago Nordenskjöld. Check in, clean up, and enjoy the dramatic views of the Cuernos directly above the refugio. Dinner and rest.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at Paine Grande — fuel up before the longest hiking day.
meals.lunch: Packed lunch at the upper Valle del Francés mirador — eat with a view of hanging glaciers.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Refugio Los Cuernos — one of the better refugio kitchens on the W, known for its lamb dishes.

day_by_day.notes: Today is the longest and most varied day of the W Trek — approximately 22–24 km total with significant elevation gain to Mirador Británico. Start no later than 07:30. The Valle del Francés section is arguably the most scenically dramatic of the entire W route. Watch for condors riding thermals above the valley walls.

day_by_day.morning: W Trek Day 4 — Final section to Las Torres. Depart Refugio Los Cuernos and hike east along the northern shore of Lago Nordenskjöld toward Hotel Las Torres (approximately 11 km). The trail passes through lenga beech forest and open pampa with constant views of the Cuernos del Paine.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Hotel Las Torres area and complete the W Trek. Celebrate with a coffee or cold drink at the hotel bar — a beloved W Trek tradition. Transfer back to Aegean Bliss Resort by park shuttle or pre-arranged vehicle.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort. Enjoy a long hot shower, unpack, and do laundry. Treat yourself to a celebratory dinner at the resort restaurant — you've completed the W Trek!

meals.breakfast: Final refugio breakfast at Los Cuernos — eat well for the last trail day.
meals.lunch: Coffee, cake, and a sandwich at Hotel Las Torres to celebrate completing the W Trek. Budget $15–20 USD.
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — splurge slightly on the Patagonian lamb asado or a seafood platter with Chilean sparkling wine.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your resort transfer from the Las Torres trailhead the day before via satellite phone or refugio radio (cell service is non-existent on the W). The W Trek total distance is approximately 70–80 km over 4 days — an outstanding achievement. Check feet for blisters and treat immediately upon return.

day_by_day.morning: Full rest and recovery day. Sleep as long as your body needs. Gentle beachfront walk after breakfast to stretch legs without any pack or pressure. Visit the resort's wellness area if available.
day_by_day.afternoon: Optional half-day drive through the park's accessible pampas roads with a resort-arranged vehicle and guide. Spot guanacos, pumas (if very lucky), Darwin's foxes, and Andean condors from the comfort of a 4x4. This is a low-effort wildlife-watching activity perfect for recovery day.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset drinks on the resort terrace. Write postcards, edit photos, and reflect on the W Trek experience. Dinner at the resort with a focus on a relaxed, multi-course meal.

meals.breakfast: Extended resort buffet breakfast — take your time.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort café — a fresh salad, soup, and juice.
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant — order the tasting menu if available, or a la carte with Chilean Malbec or Carménère wine.

day_by_day.notes: Do not underestimate the physical toll of the W Trek. A full rest day is essential before any further hiking. Use this day to reorganize gear, back up photos, and confirm remaining activity bookings. December 23 — the resort may begin festive Christmas decorations and atmosphere.

day_by_day.morning: Optional guided day hike to a lesser-visited sector of the park — consider the Sendero Mirador Ferrier or the Laguna Amarga area for flamingo watching and quieter trails away from the main W Trek crowds. Moderate 3–4 hour hike with a guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort by early afternoon. Spend the afternoon relaxing, swimming if the resort has a heated pool, or reading by the lake. Help decorate the resort common areas if the team invites guests to participate in Christmas Eve preparations.
day_by_day.evening: Christmas Eve celebration dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort. Many Patagonian lodges host a special Nochebuena (Christmas Eve) dinner with a traditional asado, local wine, and festive atmosphere. Join fellow guests for a memorable holiday dinner under the Patagonian sky.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast.
meals.lunch: Packed lunch on the morning hike — sandwiches, fruit, and thermos of soup.
meals.dinner: Special Christmas Eve Nochebuena dinner at the resort — expect a festive set menu with Patagonian lamb, seafood, and Chilean wines. Budget $45–65 USD per person for the special occasion dinner.

day_by_day.notes: Christmas Eve in Patagonia is a magical experience — long twilight, clear skies (if weather cooperates), and a warm communal atmosphere at the lodge. Confirm the special dinner format with the resort in advance and dress slightly smarter than trekking clothes for the occasion.

day_by_day.morning: Christmas morning — wake up at leisure. Enjoy a festive breakfast at the resort. Take a peaceful solo walk along the beachfront to appreciate the landscape in quiet reflection.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final adventure activity — a guided half-day horseback riding excursion through the Patagonian pampas (many estancias near Torres del Paine offer this). Ride through open grasslands with views of the Torres and Cuernos, spotting wildlife along the way. A classic Patagonian gaucho experience.
day_by_day.evening: Christmas Day dinner at the resort. Many lodges offer a special Christmas lunch or dinner. Spend the evening on the terrace watching the long Patagonian twilight, sipping pisco sours, and savoring the last full day in the park.

meals.breakfast: Festive Christmas breakfast at the resort — special spread with pastries, local cheeses, and fresh juice.
meals.lunch: Light snack during the horseback excursion or at the estancia.
meals.dinner: Christmas Day special dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — a celebratory final evening meal with wine. Budget $40–60 USD.

day_by_day.notes: Book the horseback riding excursion through the resort concierge — several estancias within 30–45 minutes of the resort offer 2–4 hour guided rides suitable for all experience levels. No prior riding experience required for most tours. Wear long pants and closed-toe shoes.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Torres del Paine. Wake early for one last sunrise walk along the beachfront — take in the view of the towers in the early morning light one final time. Enjoy a leisurely farewell breakfast at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Ensure all luggage is packed and gear is properly stored for transport. Depart by resort transfer toward Puerto Natales or Punta Arenas airport, depending on your outbound flight schedule. Stop in Puerto Natales (if time permits) for a final coffee and souvenir shopping at local artisan shops.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Patagonia. Carry the memories of the Torres, the glacier, the W Trek, and the wild Patagonian wind with you. Safe travels.

meals.breakfast: Final full resort breakfast — eat well for the long travel day ahead.
meals.lunch: Lunch in Puerto Natales if transfer schedule allows — try Afrigonia restaurant or El Living café for a great final Chilean meal. Budget $15–25 USD.
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or in-flight meal depending on departure time.

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3–4 hours of transfer time from the resort to Punta Arenas airport (approximately 3.5–4 hours by road). Puerto Natales airport has limited flight options — most international connections require passing through Punta Arenas or Santiago. Confirm your exact departure logistics with the resort at least 2 days before checkout. Patagonian wind can delay transfers — always build in buffer time.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Torres del Paine, Patagonia Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Torres del Paine, Patagonia

experiences.name: W Trek Multi-Day Hike
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic W Trek, a 4-5 day trekking route through the heart of Torres del Paine National Park. The trail connects the Valle del Francés, Grey Glacier, and the iconic Torres lookout, offering breathtaking views of granite towers, turquoise lakes, and diverse Patagonian wildlife including guanacos and condors.
experiences.location: Torres del Paine National Park, Central Circuit

experiences.name: Mirador Las Torres Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Wake before dawn and hike 4-5 hours to the iconic mirador at the base of the three granite towers. Witness the sunrise paint the towers in shades of gold and pink reflected in the glacial lagoon below. This is the most photographed and spiritually rewarding moment in all of Patagonia.
experiences.location: Valle del Ascencio, Eastern Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Grey Glacier Kayaking Expedition
experiences.description: Paddle through iceberg-studded waters alongside the massive Grey Glacier, one of Patagonia's most spectacular ice fields. A guided kayaking tour takes you up close to towering blue ice walls and floating icebergs calved from the Southern Patagonian Ice Field, offering a unique water-level perspective of this frozen giant.
experiences.location: Lago Grey, Western Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Valle del Francés Trekking Day
experiences.description: Hike through the dramatic Valle del Francés, a glacially carved valley flanked by hanging glaciers, waterfalls, and jagged peaks including Paine Grande and Cuernos del Paine. Listen for the thunderous crack of ice avalanches and spot Andean condors soaring overhead in this wild and remote wilderness corridor.
experiences.location: Valle del Francés, Central Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Lago Pehoé Catamaran & Pampas Wildlife Walk
experiences.description: Cross the stunning turquoise Lago Pehoé by catamaran with panoramic views of the Cuernos del Paine, then explore the open Patagonian pampas on a guided nature walk. Spot guanacos, ñandus (rheas), foxes, and flamingos in their natural habitat while learning about the unique Patagonian steppe ecosystem from a certified naturalist guide.
experiences.location: Lago Pehoé, Southern Sector, Torres del Paine

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival. Flight UA lands at 22:30. Transfer arranged from Punta Arenas Airport to Aegean Bliss Resort (approximately 5-hour luxury private transfer to Torres del Paine area). Settle into your Beachfront suite upon arrival.
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — in transit.
day_by_day.evening: Private late-night welcome transfer. Upon arrival at Aegean Bliss Resort, enjoy a complimentary welcome nightcap and light gourmet charcuterie board prepared by the resort's private chef. Brief orientation with your dedicated concierge. Retire early to rest ahead of the adventure.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable — in transit
meals.lunch: Not applicable — in transit
meals.dinner: Late-night welcome charcuterie board and premium Chilean wines at Aegean Bliss Resort — complimentary arrival amenity

day_by_day.notes: Private luxury transfer from Punta Arenas Airport should be pre-arranged. Ensure luggage includes trekking gear for the days ahead. Concierge will confirm activity schedule for Day 2 upon check-in.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely late-morning start to recover from travel. Enjoy a premium à la carte breakfast at the resort's panoramic dining room overlooking the Patagonian landscape. Meet with your dedicated guide and resort concierge for a comprehensive trip briefing, gear check, and weather assessment. Explore the resort grounds and beachfront area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Lago Pehoé Catamaran & Pampas Wildlife Walk — gentle introduction to the park. Cross the stunning turquoise Lago Pehoé by private catamaran with sweeping panoramic views of the Cuernos del Paine massif. Transition into a guided pampas wildlife walk spotting guanacos, Andean condors, flamingos, and Patagonian foxes. Private naturalist guide provides expert ecological commentary.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort for a sunset cocktail hour on the beachfront terrace. Indulge in a restorative spa session — deep-tissue massage or hot stone treatment recommended after travel. Private chef's tasting menu dinner featuring Patagonian lamb, king crab, and locally foraged ingredients.

meals.breakfast: À la carte gourmet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — fresh pastries, smoked salmon, farm eggs, artisan cheeses, and premium Patagonian coffee
meals.lunch: Gourmet packed picnic lunch prepared by resort chef, enjoyed lakeside during the Pampas Wildlife Walk
meals.dinner: Private chef's 5-course tasting menu at Aegean Bliss Resort featuring Patagonian lamb asado, king crab ceviche, and paired Chilean Carménère and Sauvignon Blanc

day_by_day.notes: This day serves as an acclimatization day. Pace is intentionally relaxed. Confirm W Trek logistics and multi-day gear requirements with guide this evening. Weather patterns in December can be unpredictable — flexibility is key.

day_by_day.morning: Early rise for the Mirador Las Torres Sunrise Hike — depart resort before dawn (approximately 04:30) via private vehicle transfer to the trailhead. Begin the iconic 4-5 hour guided ascent through lenga beech forest and granite boulder fields. Arrive at the mirador at the base of the three granite towers as golden sunrise light illuminates the peaks. Private guide provides geological and historical context.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend at a leisurely pace, taking time to photograph the towers and surrounding landscape. Return transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort by early afternoon. Enjoy a restorative hot lunch at the resort followed by free time for rest, reading, or a private yoga session arranged on the beachfront deck.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset walk along the resort's private beachfront. Sommelier-led Chilean wine tasting featuring premium bottles from Colchagua Valley and Casablanca Valley. Dinner at the resort's fine dining restaurant with a focus on fresh Patagonian seafood.

meals.breakfast: Pre-dawn energy breakfast at resort before departure — protein-rich selections including eggs, granola, fruit, and thermos of premium coffee and hot chocolate to take on the trail
meals.lunch: Hot gourmet lunch at Aegean Bliss Resort upon return — Patagonian lamb stew, fresh bread, and roasted seasonal vegetables
meals.dinner: Fine dining at Aegean Bliss Resort — pan-seared Patagonian trout, king crab bisque, and artisan dessert selection with paired wines

day_by_day.notes: This is the most iconic hike in Torres del Paine. Weather at the mirador can change rapidly — waterproof layers, trekking poles, and quality footwear are essential. Sunrise timing in December is approximately 05:30–06:00. The hike is strenuous (approximately 18–20 km round trip with 800m elevation gain) — pace accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning following the strenuous Mirador Las Torres hike. Sleep in and enjoy a luxurious brunch at the resort. Optional gentle nature walk along the resort's private lakefront trail with a resident naturalist, observing local birdlife including black-necked swans, upland geese, and Magellanic woodpeckers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Valle del Francés Trekking Day — afternoon segment. Private vehicle transfer to the Valle del Francés trailhead. Begin guided trek into this glacially carved valley flanked by hanging glaciers, dramatic waterfalls, and towering granite walls. Hike to Mirador Británico viewpoint for extraordinary panoramic views of the valley and surrounding peaks. Expert guide narrates glacial geology and Patagonian ecology.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort by early evening. Private hot tub session on the beachfront suite terrace under the Patagonian sky. Candlelit dinner at the resort featuring a curated asado (traditional Patagonian barbecue) prepared tableside by the private chef.

meals.breakfast: Extended late brunch at Aegean Bliss Resort — eggs Benedict, avocado toast, fresh fruit platters, artisan pastries, and premium sparkling wine
meals.lunch: Gourmet trail lunch at Valle del Francés — insulated containers with hot soup, premium sandwiches, energy snacks, and fresh fruit prepared by resort chef
meals.dinner: Private asado dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — whole-roasted Patagonian lamb, chimichurri, roasted vegetables, and premium Malbec

day_by_day.notes: Valle del Francés is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve zone. Hanging glaciers calve frequently — listen for dramatic ice falls from Glaciar del Francés above. The afternoon start allows recovery time from Day 3. Full-day option available if energy permits — discuss with guide.

day_by_day.morning: W Trek Multi-Day Hike — Day 1 of 4. Depart resort with pre-packed luxury trekking kit. Begin the iconic W Trek from the eastern arm (Las Torres sector). Guided hike through the lenga beech forest toward Campamento Chileno. Private guide leads the group with expert ecological and geological narration throughout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking along the W route toward the central valley. Arrive at luxury tented camp or premium mountain refuge accommodation pre-arranged along the W Trek route. Unpack, freshen up, and enjoy the extraordinary remote wilderness setting.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset views from the refuge terrace. Hot gourmet dinner at the mountain refuge prepared by an on-site chef. Stargazing session guided by your naturalist — December nights in Patagonia offer extraordinary Southern Hemisphere skies including the Milky Way and Magellanic Clouds.

meals.breakfast: Hearty packed breakfast prepared by Aegean Bliss Resort chef before departure — energy bars, fresh fruit, thermos coffee, and warm pastries
meals.lunch: Gourmet packed trail lunch at a scenic viewpoint along the W Trek route
meals.dinner: Premium mountain refuge dinner — hearty Patagonian cuisine with wine, hot soups, and locally sourced ingredients

day_by_day.notes: Luggage for the W Trek should be limited to a quality daypack or small trekking bag — resort will store main luggage. Luxury porter service can be arranged to carry heavier loads. Premium W Trek refuges (EcoCamp Patagonia or Explora-style lodges) should be pre-booked months in advance for December peak season.

day_by_day.morning: W Trek Multi-Day Hike — Day 2. Early breakfast at the mountain refuge. Continue westward along the W Trek route through the central sector, traversing the stunning mirador overlooking Lago Nordenskjöld. Pass through the iconic Cuernos del Paine viewpoints with dramatic close-up perspectives of the horned granite towers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Trek into the Valle del Francés from the western approach — a different perspective than Day 4's visit. Ascend toward Mirador Británico for a second visit with a fresh vantage point. Descend to the next refuge or luxury camp along the route for overnight stay.
day_by_day.evening: Communal dinner at the premium refuge with fellow trekkers. Evening reflection and journaling time. Optional guided evening nature walk around the refuge area to spot nocturnal wildlife.

meals.breakfast: Full hot breakfast at mountain refuge — porridge, eggs, toast, fresh fruit, and coffee
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet trail lunch at Mirador Británico — premium sandwiches, cheese, charcuterie, and energy snacks
meals.dinner: Hot three-course dinner at mountain refuge — soup, main course of Patagonian lamb or trout, and dessert with wine

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 of the W Trek covers approximately 12–15 km with moderate elevation changes. Patagonian weather can shift dramatically — wind speeds in the valley can exceed 100 km/h. Always carry full waterproof layers and windproof jacket. Trekking poles strongly recommended.

day_by_day.morning: W Trek Multi-Day Hike — Day 3. Early start from central refuge. Trek westward toward the Grey Glacier sector — the most dramatic section of the W Trek. Pass through open Patagonian steppe with panoramic views of Lago Grey. First views of the Grey Glacier's blue ice face emerge from the trail.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Lago Grey and the Grey Glacier viewpoints. Extended time at the glacier mirador to observe the massive ice field and floating icebergs. Afternoon rest at the Grey sector premium refuge. Optional short exploratory walk along the lakeshore to observe ice formations up close.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset over Lago Grey and the Grey Glacier — one of the most spectacular light shows in Patagonia as the ice turns pink and gold. Premium dinner at Grey refuge. Celebratory toast marking the halfway point of the W Trek.

meals.breakfast: Full hot breakfast at mountain refuge before departure
meals.lunch: Packed trail lunch enjoyed at a panoramic viewpoint overlooking Lago Grey
meals.dinner: Celebratory premium dinner at Grey Glacier refuge — special menu with Patagonian king crab, lamb, and premium Chilean wines

day_by_day.notes: The Grey Glacier is retreating due to climate change — current conditions may differ from maps. December offers long daylight hours (up to 17+ hours of light) maximizing trekking time. The glacier face is approximately 6 km wide and 30 meters high — an awe-inspiring sight.

day_by_day.morning: W Trek Multi-Day Hike — Day 4 (Final Day). Early morning Grey Glacier Kayaking Expedition — the crown jewel of the W Trek experience. Don dry suits and paddle through iceberg-studded turquoise waters alongside the massive Grey Glacier face. Private expert guide leads the 3-4 hour kayaking expedition with close-up views of calving ice formations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Complete the W Trek with the return hike from Grey sector. Private vehicle pickup at the western trailhead for luxury transfer back to Aegean Bliss Resort. Arrive at resort for a triumphant return — hot shower, resort amenities, and a well-earned rest.
day_by_day.evening: W Trek completion celebration dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort. Private chef's special tasting menu in honor of completing the iconic route. Champagne toast, premium wine pairing, and gourmet Patagonian feast. Optional post-dinner spa treatment — deep-tissue recovery massage.

meals.breakfast: Pre-kayaking energy breakfast at Grey refuge — high-protein selections and hot drinks
meals.lunch: Hot gourmet welcome-back lunch at Aegean Bliss Resort upon return — resort's full menu available
meals.dinner: W Trek completion celebration — 7-course chef's tasting menu at Aegean Bliss Resort with premium Champagne and wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Grey Glacier kayaking requires a minimum fitness level and comfort with water activities. Dry suits are provided. All safety equipment is included. The kayaking expedition is weather-dependent and may be rescheduled by the guide if conditions are unsafe. This is the experiential highlight of the entire trip.

day_by_day.morning: Full rest and recovery day at Aegean Bliss Resort. Sleep in, enjoy a leisurely beachfront breakfast, and take advantage of the resort's full luxury amenities. Optional guided birdwatching walk on the resort grounds — December is peak season for Andean condor sightings and migratory bird species.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private photography session with a resort-arranged professional Patagonian landscape photographer. Explore the most photogenic viewpoints near the resort — golden hour light in December creates extraordinary conditions. Alternatively, enjoy a private fly-fishing excursion on nearby Patagonian rivers and lakes (catch-and-release, premium gear provided).
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails on the beachfront terrace with panoramic views of the Cuernos del Paine. Private wine and cheese pairing curated by the resort sommelier. Intimate candlelit dinner for two at the resort's most exclusive table with unobstructed water views.

meals.breakfast: Luxurious late breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — full à la carte menu with freshly baked pastries, smoked fish, premium eggs, and Patagonian coffee
meals.lunch: Light resort lunch — ceviche, fresh salads, artisan sandwiches, and fresh-pressed juices at the beachfront dining terrace
meals.dinner: Romantic candlelit dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort beachfront — Patagonian seafood tower, truffle risotto, and premium dessert selection

day_by_day.notes: This is a deliberately unscheduled recovery day. After 4 days of W Trek trekking, rest is essential. The photography session or fly-fishing activity should be confirmed with the concierge the previous evening. December 23rd marks the approach of the holiday season — resort may have special seasonal decorations and menus.

day_by_day.morning: Christmas Eve adventure — private full-day exploration of Torres del Paine's lesser-visited sectors. Morning guided hike to Mirador Condor, a hidden viewpoint offering sweeping views of the entire park with minimal crowds. Expert naturalist guide accompanies with telescopes for condor and puma spotting.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private puma tracking expedition with a specialist wildlife guide — Torres del Paine has one of the world's highest densities of pumas. Travel by 4x4 to prime puma habitat in the park's quieter southern sectors. Patient observation from safe distances — sightings are not guaranteed but the probability in December is high.
day_by_day.evening: Christmas Eve gala dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort. Special holiday tasting menu featuring the finest Patagonian ingredients — whole-roasted lamb, king crab, and artisan desserts. Live acoustic music, Champagne, and festive atmosphere. Midnight toast under the Patagonian stars.

meals.breakfast: Early Christmas Eve breakfast at resort — special holiday pastries, fresh fruit, and festive Champagne mimosas
meals.lunch: Gourmet picnic lunch in the field during the puma tracking expedition — premium selections in insulated containers
meals.dinner: Christmas Eve gala dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — 8-course holiday tasting menu with Champagne and premium wine pairing, live music

day_by_day.notes: Puma sightings are one of the most sought-after wildlife experiences in Patagonia. December and January are prime months as pumas are active during long daylight hours. The specialist puma guide should be booked in advance through the resort. Patience and silence are essential — this is a premium wildlife experience requiring respect for the animals.

day_by_day.morning: Christmas Day — sunrise horseback riding through the Patagonian pampas. Depart at dawn on premium Chilean horses with an expert gaucho guide. Ride through open steppe with panoramic views of the Torres del Paine massif bathed in Christmas morning light. Encounter guanacos, ñandus (Patagonian ostriches), and condors from horseback.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort for a Christmas Day brunch celebration. Afternoon of pure leisure — private beachfront time, resort pool or hot tub, and optional guided meditation session on the lakefront. Alternatively, a second visit to a favorite viewpoint or a short independent nature walk near the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Christmas Day special dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — traditional Patagonian Christmas feast. Whole-roasted Patagonian lamb (cordero al palo), fresh king crab, artisan breads, and festive desserts. Premium Champagne, curated wine selection, and festive seasonal cocktails. Exchange of small gifts with resort staff — a cherished Patagonian Christmas tradition.

meals.breakfast: Pre-ride energy snack at resort — thermos of hot chocolate and coffee, energy bars, and fresh fruit
meals.lunch: Christmas Day brunch at Aegean Bliss Resort — lavish holiday spread with Champagne, smoked salmon, oysters, artisan cheeses, and festive pastries
meals.dinner: Christmas Day feast at Aegean Bliss Resort — cordero al palo, king crab, traditional Chilean Christmas dishes, and premium Champagne

day_by_day.notes: Christmas Day in Patagonia is a magical experience — long summer daylight (approximately 17 hours of light) and the unique Southern Hemisphere summer Christmas atmosphere is unforgettable. Horseback riding should be pre-arranged through the resort. Rider experience levels will be assessed before departure.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Patagonia. Early sunrise walk along the resort's private beachfront for one last immersive experience of the Patagonian landscape. Pack and prepare for departure. Final breakfast at the resort with the full à la carte menu. Personal farewell meeting with concierge and guides — exchange memories, tips, and recommendations for future visits.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisurely late checkout (pre-arranged with resort). Final drive through Torres del Paine National Park en route to Punta Arenas — stop at key viewpoints including Lago Sarmiento and the park entrance for final photographs. Arrive in Punta Arenas for onward travel arrangements. Optional last lunch in Punta Arenas at a premium local restaurant.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Punta Arenas. Reflect on an extraordinary 12-day premium Patagonian adventure — the W Trek, Grey Glacier kayaking, puma tracking, Christmas in the wilderness, and the timeless beauty of Torres del Paine.

meals.breakfast: Final farewell breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — full à la carte menu, special farewell pastry selection from the chef, and premium Patagonian coffee
meals.lunch: Premium lunch in Punta Arenas — La Marmita or Sotito's Bar & Restaurant for fresh Patagonian king crab and local seafood specialties
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or airport lounge dining in Punta Arenas — resort can arrange a premium packed farewell meal for the journey

day_by_day.notes: Late checkout should be confirmed with the resort at least 2 days in advance. The transfer from Torres del Paine to Punta Arenas takes approximately 5 hours — plan departure timing accordingly based on onward flight schedule. Ensure all trekking gear, photography equipment, and souvenirs are packed the evening before. The resort can arrange shipping of any oversized items or gear purchases.
